clues.text: When the other disciples announced, "We have seen the Lord!", this one of the Twelve had been away.
The risen Jesus told this disciple, "Because you have seen Me, you have believed."
Seeing the risen Jesus with his own eyes, this apostle cried out, "My Lord and my God!"
When Jesus said He was going to prepare a place, this disciple asked how they could know the way.
When Jesus set out to go to dead Lazarus, this disciple urged the others to go and die with Him.
When Jesus sent out the twelve apostles, this one was named alongside Matthew the tax collector.
Behind locked doors, the risen Jesus invited this disciple to look at His hands and reach into His side.
